posts.title: RDS-37: First Soviet thermonuclear weapon test (1955)
posts.description: Date: 22 November 1955 Code Name: RDS-37 or “Kuzka’s Mother” Type: two-stage fusion Yield: 1,600 kilotons of TNT Location: Semipalatinsk, Kazakhstan RDS is a transliteration of the Russian РДС, which stands for Реактивный Двигатель Сталина, Reaktivniy Dvigatel’ Stalina, or “Stalin’s Jet Engine”.

posts.title: Verrazano Narrows Bridge opened to traffic (1964)
posts.description: On the day it opened the Verrazano Narrows Bridge was the world’s longest suspended span.

posts.title: Luna 17 lands on the moon, Lunokhod 1 drives away (1970)
posts.description: Lunokhod 1 was the first roving remote-controlled robot to land on another celestial body. It rolled off the Luna 17 lander two and a half hours after landing and operated for nearly 10 months from November 1970 to September 1971. Although equipped with a laser retroreflector array, was “lost” at the end of the mission […]
